Subject: Request: Executive approval for >20% discount for Novamed Hosted API

Team —

Quick ask: Novamed is pushing back on our standard Hosted API pricing and is requesting a 25% discount off list for a 12-month committed consumption agreement (they're targeting ~ $1.8M committed usage over 12 months). Sales has negotiated down to ~25% and procurement says they need a final exec approval to accept anything >20%.

Why this matters:
- Novamed is a potential marquee healthcare reference in the EU+US — large clinical partner network and three pilots ready to go if pricing approved.
- They are evaluating alternative vendors but prefer Redwood for latency and observability.
- Risk: without >20% concession they will walk to a competitor and pull pilots (we lose momentum with their product roadmap).

Proposal from Sales (attached):
- Offer 25% off Hosted API unit rates
- 12-month committed minimum spend: $1.8M total (monthly drawdown)
- Add a 90-day implementation and co-marketing clause, and 60-day payment terms

Ask: Marissa / Vivek — can we approve a one-time exception for 25% discount contingent on the attached Commitment and prepayment cadence? Need decision by EOD Wed 3/18 to keep their procurement window.

Attachments: Novamed_MAProposal_v4.pdf, SOW_summary.xlsx, pricing_breakdown.csv

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

A couple quick clarifying Qs for the deal economics before I escalate formally to leadership:
1) Confirmed committed ARR / total contract value (numbers in the attachment looked like spend run-rate, need annualized TCV).
2) What is the likelihood they will convert to Dedicated or Private within 12 months? If high, we can consider a deeper short-term discount with conversion credits.
3) Any legal terms they insist on that change our standard termination or indemnities?

Marcus — can you please run a margin impact at 22.5% and 25% (with the prepay condition) and tag which option would require CFO sign-off? Laura — looping you for the margin threshold. Need to move quickly; procurement timeline is tight.

Marissa / team —

Attached the simple economics (pricing_breakdown.csv). Key points:
- TCV (reported by procurement) = ~$1.8M over 12 months (monthly drawdown).
- At 25% off list our gross margin on Hosted API would drop to ~30% before infra credits; at 22.5% it's ~34%.
- Probability they walk if we stay >=20% discount threshold: high (they've flagged two other vendors as ready to move).
- Upside: if we tie a conversion credit (credit toward Dedicated setup) on year-2, conversion likelihood increases materially.

My recommendation: Approve 25% only if Novamed agrees to prepay 6 months up front OR signs a 12-month pre-commit with monthly auto-billing plus co-marketing. If prepay is not acceptable, consider 22.5% + commit to look at Dedicated conversion credits.

I flagged which cells would require Laura/CFO sign-off in the spreadsheet. Happy to jump on a 15-min quick call to run numbers.

Thanks,

Team —

Reviewed Marcus's spreadsheet. Finance position: we cannot approve >20% list discount on Hosted API under standard payment terms without executive sign-off. Our guidance: max 20% standard unless there is one of the following:

- Prepayment for at least 6 months (preferred), or
- 12-month firm commit with irrevocable monthly billing and a 30-day termination clause tied to usage minimums, or
- A material marketing/reseller commitment that demonstrably increases downstream ARR.

If the team insists on 25% with standard 60-day net terms, that requires CFO + CEO approval. If Rishi/Marcus can secure 50% upfront or confirmed Dedicated conversion in year 2, Finance can rubber-stamp 25% with legal sign-off on amended payment terms.

I'll make time for a quick call to finalize the exact financial covenant if leadership wants to proceed.

-Laura

Thanks for the detailed thread. Quick decision to keep Novamed engaged — approve an exception to allow up to 25% off Hosted API unit pricing under the following conditions (must be in the SOW and MA):

1) Minimum 12-month commitment = $1.8M TCV (as stated).
2) At least 3 months prepayment or a confirmed 6-month upfront payment schedule.
3) Novamed agrees to a marketing/reference agreement (press release + joint case study) to be completed within 9 months of launch.
4) Standard legal indemnities remain; no change to our data residency & audit clauses.

This exception is time-limited and tied to this signature only; any conversion to Dedicated will be handled as a separate commercial negotiation and may include conversion credits. Marcus/Rishi — proceed to update the proposal and attach the revised SOW for legal. Laura, please confirm accounting entries and any revenue recognition adjustments required.

Vivek
